01-01.title: New Year's Day
01-01.text: Every word you learn today is a seed for tomorrow's conversations. Start the year strong.

02-14.title: Valentine's Day
02-14.text: Fall in love with the process of learning. Fluency is a journey of passion.

04-22.title: Earth Day
04-22.text: Language is the bridge that connects our global community. Keep expanding your world.

07-30.title: International Friendship Day
07-30.text: A new language is an open door to millions of potential new friends. Step through it.

10-31.title: Halloween
10-31.text: Don't let difficult grammar frighten you. Face your mistakes and turn them into mastery.

11-28.title: Thanksgiving
11-28.text: Be thankful for the progress you've made. Your past effort is today's foundation.

12-25.title: Christmas
12-25.text: Give yourself the greatest gift of all: the ability to express your true thoughts globally.

12-31.title: New Year's Eve
12-31.text: Look back at how much your vocabulary has grown. Tomorrow is a blank page waiting for your voice.
